title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Citrus, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as Citrus National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Citrus, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as Citrus National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Citrus, Thành phố San Jose Del Monte, Tỉnh Bulacan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Citrus
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Citrus, เมือง San Jose Del Monte, จังหวัด Bulacan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Citrus

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Citrus, City of San Jose del Monte, Province of Bulacan to be known as Citrus National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Citrus National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
